etsy.title: Rally Time Card Poster, Pace Notes Wall Art, Funny Co Driver Gift, Motorsport Sign for Garage
etsy.description:
A funny rally time card poster in the style of a crew copy: stage SS5, 14.2 km of gravel, weather yes, driver calm, co-driver lying.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang in a garage, man cave, office, or on a rally fan's wall. A good fit for the co-driver who keeps the pace notes.

No team, series, or manufacturer marks: just generic rally humor.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: A search for a rally time card co-driver print found no time-card posters; co-driver items are name stickers/decals, a navigator hoodie, and mugs.
Pace-notes wording appears only on mugs and shirts (keyword file), so the time card plus pace-notes angle is an open gap.

searchPhrases: retro rally car wall art poster unframed garage
funny racing sign poster man cave garage
competitorNotes: Amazon rally prints are mostly watercolor real-car paintings sold unframed in 8x10 to 16x20, pitched for garage and man cave walls and as a gift for car enthusiasts.
Funny racing wall decor on Amazon is dominated by 8x12 metal tin signs (speed-limit and parking jokes); no co-driver or pace-note jokes surfaced.

research.notes: 'rally time card' is the printed subject, not a confirmed indexed phrase; the indexed and seen phrases (pace notes, co driver gift, motorsport sign) carry the rest of the title and tags. No priceRange: no comparable physical time-card posters found.
